detail.longDescription: 🤖 AgentCorruption (Zenity Labs): one prompt to a public Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agent → SSRF to the EC2 metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254) → execution-role creds → reach every agent in the account (chats, memories, API keys, Secrets Manager). AWS fixed it (IMDSv2 required) and disputes it's a vuln. 🔗 https:// cybersecuritynews.com/agentcor ruption-attack/ # AIAgents # PromptInjection # CloudSecurity # CyberSec
